title: acer opalus subsp. neapolitanum
intro: Acer opalus subsp. neapolitanum, commonly known as the Neapolitan maple, is a subspecies of maple tree native to Europe. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional European folk medicine. The health benefits of Acer opalus subsp. neapolitanum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities.
